old_description: Not all items available are shown on website - Please call us for more info )
about:
West Bend Woolen Mills Store operates from West Bend, Wisconsin. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business carries the name "Woolen Mills," though its current iteration functions as a retail destination.

The store stocks a broad range of work wear, outdoor clothing, and formal wear from brands such as Carhartt, Wigwam, Stormy Kromer, Buck Wear, Choko Designs, Old Friend Slippers, and DuBois Formal Wear. Inventory spans socks, slippers, headwear, gloves, outerwear, pants, shirts, and home goods including wool blankets and woven towels. The company also operates a tuxedo rental service with in-house measuring, offering packages starting at $189.99 for adults.

Customers include construction and manufacturing professionals, tradespeople, farmers, outdoor enthusiasts, and local schools seeking spirit wear. The retailer serves both individual consumers and organizations needing work apparel or formal attire for events.

The company emphasizes personal service, particularly for formal wear fittings, and promotes a large selection of brands. Free shipping is offered on orders over $75.

name: West Michigan Food Equipment
old_description: New restaurant equipment: Restaurant Equipment, Bar Equipment, Hood Systems and more.
about:
West Michigan Food Equipment operates from Zeeland, Michigan, as a family-owned supplier of commercial food equipment. The business is led by Marcus, who grew up in the industry and runs the company with his family. While a specific founding year is not disclosed, the team brings over 25 years of combined experience in food service equipment.

The company provides new and refurbished restaurant equipment ranging from mixers and ranges to walk-in coolers and freezers, along with small wares, furniture, and parts. It also offers custom fabrication — such as a kitchen prep table built and delivered in four hours — plus kitchen design, equipment installation, project coordination, and health department plan review assistance. Operations run out of a warehouse where customers can inspect equipment firsthand.

Customers include restaurants, bars, coffee shops, churches, schools, and other food service facilities across West Michigan and nationwide. The company has outfitted projects such as a pizza and Italian carry-out startup and a micro bakery, and works with concession and quick-serve operations.

West Michigan Food Equipment emphasizes a customer-first partnership, guiding clients from initial sketches through city inspections. Its differentiators include rapid custom turnaround, end-to-end project management, and a combined inventory of new and reconditioned equipment backed by decades of industry experience.

name: West Wood Manufacturing
old_description: We started twenty-five years ago building custom made cabinetry. As trends come and go, style and tastes change, one thing holds true - the kitchen is the heart of the home.
about:
West Wood Manufacturing operates from Bradenton, Florida, serving the Bradenton and Sarasota areas. The company was established in 1998, beginning as a custom cabinetry shop. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and founders are not named in available sources.

The company designs, manufactures, delivers, and installs custom cabinetry including kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, built-ins, outdoor kitchens, and specialty millwork. All fabrication occurs in-house, allowing control over materials such as solid woods, laminates, veneers, hardware, countertops, and finishes.

Primary customers are residential homeowners in the Bradenton-Sarasota region seeking luxury custom cabinetry. The firm also collaborates with design professionals, notably HIVE ARCHITECTS, on custom projects. Services extend to custom furniture, Murphy beds, closets, offices, and entertainment centers.

West Wood emphasizes that in-house production eliminates reliance on third parties, enabling faster turnaround and deeper customization than competitors. The company uses its own trucks and drivers for delivery, performs final quality checks before shipment, and provides professional installation. The founding premise remains building cabinets that stand the test of time with personalized details.

name: Western Casework Corporation
old_description: Western Casework is proud to have served the Las Vegas area for over 36 years, providing millwork and cabinetry needs for your growing business.
about:
Western Casework Corporation operates from North Las Vegas, Nevada, where it has served the Las Vegas area for over 36 years. The company specializes in millwork and cabinetry for commercial projects.

The firm runs a 50,000-square-foot facility equipped with state-of-the-art design technology and millwork machinery, producing custom casework, architectural woodworking, and cabinetry for a range of commercial and institutional clients. No headcount or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Its project portfolio spans hospitality, healthcare, government, banking, automotive, and entertainment sectors. Completed work includes millwork for the Hampton Inn and Suites, Comprehensive Cancer Center, Nellis Air Force Base, Nevada State Museum, Juhl High Rise Condo Tower, and multiple bank branches such as Nevada State Bank and Bank of George. The company also serves retail clients like Red Rock Harley Davidson and Fletcher Jones Toyota, as well as non-profit organizations including the Boys & Girls Club.

Western Casework emphasizes its long-standing local presence and the capacity of its large, technology-driven shop to deliver products that exceed client expectations.

name: Western Montana Specialty Foods
old_description: This product is organic, vegan, kosher, non-gmo and gluten free.
about:
Western Montana Specialty Foods operates from Superior, Montana, where it produces a line of zucchini relishes under the Bitterroot brand. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The product lineup consists of three flavors: Bitterroot Sweet Zucchini Relish, Bitterroot Dill Zucchini Relish, and Bitterroot Sweet with a Little Heat Zucchini Relish. Each variety is formulated without artificial preservatives or colors, using organic and natural ingredients that are certified vegan, kosher, non-GMO, and gluten-free. The relishes are packaged in 12-ounce jars and sold with a minimum order of three jars. The company fulfills orders directly from its Montana facility, offering free shipping on all domestic orders.

Western Montana Specialty Foods sells primarily direct to consumers through its e-commerce site. The input does not specify wholesale channels or industrial customers, though the product attributes suggest suitability for specialty food retailers, natural grocery chains, and food-service operators seeking clean-label condiments.

The brand leans on the regional lore of the bitterroot flower, a native plant with historical significance in western Montana, to differentiate its products. The company emphasizes its clean-label credentials—organic, vegan, kosher, non-GMO, and gluten-free—as its primary market distinction.

old_description: We are your one-stop shop for all your auto part needs. Check with our
about:
Western Motors Auto Parts operates from Casper, Wyoming, supplying automotive replacement parts to repair shops and other buyers. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business maintains a broad catalog of OEM and aftermarket components, including wiring harnesses, diesel particulate filters, bumper assemblies, and numerous mechanical and electrical assemblies. Customers can search for parts by year, make, and model through the company's online system, which promises identification within 24 to 48 hours. The firm states it provides daily delivery service across its region.

Western Motors serves the automotive repair industry, stocking parts for a wide range of domestic and import vehicles from manufacturers such as Ford, Chevrolet, Toyota, Honda, and many others. Its inventory covers vehicles dating back to the early 1900s through current model years, with specific coverage for parts like A/C wiring harnesses, accelerator parts, body wiring harnesses, charging port door assemblies, dash wiring harnesses, engine wiring harnesses, exhaust assemblies, floor shift assemblies, front axle assemblies, front bumper assemblies, front end assemblies, front seat belt assemblies, and headlight assemblies.

The company emphasizes communication-driven service, guaranteeing the condition of parts sold and aiming for unified customer support. It positions itself as a one-stop shop for hard-to-find components.

name: Western Solar Inc
old_description: Going solar is one of the best decisions you can make for your home, your future, and our planet, and we’re honored to be part of your journey.
about:
Western Solar Inc was founded in 2002 in Bellingham, Washington, the seat of Whatcom County. The locally owned company began with a mission to bring high-quality solar solutions to homeowners and businesses across the state, advocating early for net‑metering policies that would make solar financially viable for more customers.

The firm provides full‑service solar photovoltaic design, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance, along with energy‑storage systems, electric‑vehicle chargers, and smart electrical panels. All work is performed in‑house by a crew of electricians, roofers, and designers—no subcontractors are used. Since inception, Western Solar has installed more than 3,000 residential and commercial systems throughout Washington, drawing on nearly a century of combined team experience.

Customers range from individual homeowners in communities such as Freeland, Ferndale, and Bellingham to commercial and institutional clients. A notable project is the Fisherman’s Pavilion community solar array on the Bellingham waterfront, developed in partnership with the Port of Bellingham, Puget Sound Energy, Silfab Solar, and Cascadia Renewables. The company also collaborates with local utilities to advance smart‑home energy solutions.

Western Solar distinguishes itself through an integrated, no‑subcontractor model that covers design through lifetime service, a commitment to consumer‑protection advocacy through the Washington Solar Energy Industries Association (WASEIA), and a focus on integrity and craftsmanship rather than high‑pressure sales.

name: Western States Circuit Breaker
old_description: Meeting and exceeding your electrical switchgear needs since 1989
about:
Western States Circuit Breakers, Inc. was founded in 1989 in Idaho Falls, Idaho. The company has operated continuously from its Idaho headquarters for over three decades.

The firm specializes in remanufacturing and reconditioning existing circuit breakers and switchgear, while also supplying new, obsolete, and reconditioned units across all major brands. Its product range covers molded-case breakers, air-frame circuit breakers, medium-voltage breakers, motor-control-center components, contactors, starters, and a wide assortment of replacement parts such as shunt trips, bell alarms, UVR devices, actuators, closing coils, contacts, arc chutes, programmers, auxiliary devices, disconnects, and charging handles. In addition to parts supply, the company provides onsite and in-shop testing, inspection, primary and secondary testing, and maintenance programs for electrical switchgear.

Western States serves customers that require reliable circuit-breaker and switchgear solutions, including industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and utility operations that need replacement, repair, or retrofit services for their electrical distribution equipment.

The company emphasizes its long-standing focus on remanufacturing and reconditioning as its core differentiator, positioning itself as a single source for both legacy and current switchgear needs since 1989.
